description: Frozen review-reward benchmark built from terminal Slack thread contexts plus final eval artifacts when available. Each case stores the reference first-pass underwrite, the accepted target decision, and review-friction metadata so candidate underwriting can be judged on correct estimate-versus-escalate behavior, evidence coverage, calibration, and projection accuracy when an estimate is warranted.

input.address: 1176 N Francis Gate Circle, Francis, UT 84036

referenceInitial.methodology: Projections generated from Zillow listing facts using price-based gross-yield heuristics as the anchor, plus bedroom-count, property-type, and STR-permission heuristics. This is not a Park City market-knowledge underwrite and should be treated as a lower-confidence on-demand estimate for a single family residence. Balanced occupancy was anchored around 55% with scenario spreads applied above and below that baseline.

grounding.summary: MLS source listing; listing acquisition tool via flexmls_scrape

sources.label: MLS source listing
sources.note: 1176 N Francis Gate Circle, Francis, UT 84036

approvedTarget.methodology: Manual thread adjustment applied from operator guidance: keep the existing occupancy curves, anchor the Balanced case at about $130,000 annual revenue, and rescale Optimized and Conservative from that same ADR baseline. This remains a lower-confidence off-market estimate rather than a Park City comp-backed underwrite.
